services: Association membership for independent postsecondary schools and colleges.
Associate membership for companies supporting the private postsecondary education sector.
Continuing education and discounted training through the APSA Online Training Center.
Direct institutional assistance around licensing, Arizona State Board for Private Postsecondary Education renewal, accreditation, compliance, and regulatory questions.
Networking, annual conference, fundraisers, workshops, and training expo opportunities.
Scholarship programs including APSA AZ High School Scholarship and Life Long Learning Scholarship.
audiences: Vendors and service providers supporting private postsecondary education.
Administrators, educators, and school owners in Arizona private career education.
Arizona students eligible for APSA scholarship programs.
confirmed_facts.address: 9375 E Shea Blvd, Suite 100, Scottsdale, AZ 85260
confirmed_facts.hours: Public office hours were not found on the official pages reviewed; contact directly.
differentiators: Official home page says APSA has been the recognized voice for Private Postsecondary Education in Arizona since 1967.
Official membership page describes APSA as the oldest and largest association of private postsecondary schools in Arizona.
Online Training Center offers more than 100 courses, plus free tutorials and lessons.
Official contact page lists Susan Ciardullo as Executive Director.
trust_signals: Official site publishes phone and Scottsdale contact address.
Official pages list active membership, training, scholarship, and event programs.
Local record is backed by the Greater Phoenix Chamber directory source_url.
products: Annual conference and training expo access.
pricing_notes: Membership pricing was not visible in the official pages reviewed; join/renew flows should be checked for current dues.
Official 2026 high school scholarship page states participating member institutions offer a $1,000 scholarship, or $500 for programs shorter than 13 weeks.
Official Life Long Learning scholarship page lists a $500 award.
